Corollary
1. Corollary 1.27\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0019 ↗ hanlin:lemma-harnack-ball A harmonic function on $\mathbb R^n$ bounded above or below is constant.
Proof

\sketch Normalize to $u\ge 0$ and apply Lemma 4 on $B_R(0)$ for fixed $x$. Let $R\to \infty $; both comparison factors tend to one.

□
